title: Extract shared execution-integrity mechanics without merging orchestration and recovery semantics
claim: Project Runner and WIP appear to implement materially overlapping mechanical invariants around exact work/effect identity, optimistic concurrency, verification, and recovery. A narrow shared integrity contract may reduce duplicated machinery while Project Runner retains orchestration semantics and WIP retains crash-recovery/workspace semantics.
preserved_boundaries: Project Runner remains owner of work graph, dispatch, budgets, backend capability, target authority, leases, and completion semantics.
WIP remains owner of workspace recovery cadence, checkpoint history, continuation surfaces, and ambiguous-effect recovery workflow.
A shared contract may define mechanical fields/states but may not make either repository authoritative over the other.
promotion_evidence: Project Runner main documents generation CAS, fenced leases, expected-state mutation checks, post-write readback, and independent completion evidence.
WIP main documents HEAD generation optimistic concurrency plus PREPARED -> ATTEMPTED -> VERIFIED/FAILED/AMBIGUOUS effect journaling and reconcile-before-retry behavior.
rejection_conditions: The proposed common contract requires Project Runner-specific scheduling semantics.
The proposed common contract requires WIP-specific workspace/checkpoint lifecycle semantics.
Adapters needed to share the contract exceed the duplicated implementation removed.
A common state vocabulary creates ambiguity between execution completion and recovery reconciliation.
Either project loses a viable standalone path.

critical_objections: The overlap may be conceptual rather than implementation-level; extracting a library too early could duplicate both systems a third time.
Project Runner's lease/fence semantics and WIP's operation-journal semantics solve different failure windows even when they use similar words.
The first experiment should compare exact field/state mappings before any shared code is written.

notes: This candidate was generated after the full portfolio census rather than being one of the original hand-picked seed experiments.
Active Project Runner M6 work exists beyond main; exact experiment heads must be refreshed before implementation.
